item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli air strikes in Gaza have killed a senior Hamas security official, his wife and children, and separately eliminated Hamas’s Gaza security chief, as well as Hamas’s internal security chief and a likely replacement. The United Nations warned that the Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development and that the risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians is widening. Winter rains are threatening about 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, prompting council warnings. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ethiopia offered to host inclusive Sudan peace talks and propose a national unity government, but Sudan rejected the offer and questioned Ethiopia's neutrality.
